verdict: Lead flow has collapsed to near zero; the primary call campaign is paused and needs immediate attention.
diagnosis: Spend of $7,220 produced only 2 leads this period while the main search campaign sits paused, starving the pipeline.

signals.headline: Only 2 leads from $7,220 spend
signals.detail: Cost per lead landed near $3,610 this period, far above any healthcare benchmark. Tracking or campaign setup likely broken.

signals.headline: Main search campaign paused
signals.detail: The BWS Search Calls campaign is off. Zero impressions on the latest day explain the lead drought.

signals.headline: 9 purchases worth $5,897 recorded
signals.detail: Sales are still coming through at roughly $655 per order, suggesting demand exists when ads actually run.

signals.headline: Only 1 call click in 28 days
signals.detail: Google Business Profile is driving directions (205) but almost no phone calls, unusual for a medical alert buyer.

signals.headline: Click-through rate at 0.08%
signals.detail: Well below the 4.95% medical device search benchmark. Creative or keyword match quality needs a hard look.

benchmark.label: Benchmark
benchmark.body: Healthcare search ads average $66 per lead, with top performers near $30. Google health and wellness click costs sit around $1.63. Liferun's $2.08 average click cost is competitive; the lead count is not.

seasonal.label: Seasonal
seasonal.subheader: November is peak senior safety buying
seasonal.body: Adult children researching medical alerts for aging parents peak heading into holidays and winter fall-risk season. Pausing the call campaign now misses the strongest intent window of the year.

competitor.label: Competitor
competitor.subheader: Bay Alarm, Medical Alert, Aloe Care active
competitor.body: Ten major brands including Bay Alarm Medical, Medical Alert, LogicMark and Aloe Care are actively marketing smartwatch and fall-detection devices this month. Category is crowded and competing on wearables.

recommendations.title: Turn the paused Search Calls campaign back on
recommendations.detail: This is the single biggest fix. Confirm billing, budget caps, and policy status before relaunch. Expect lead volume to recover within days once impressions resume.

recommendations.title: Audit lead tracking before adding spend
recommendations.detail: Only 2 leads against 4,653 clicks suggests a pixel or form issue. Verify Facebook pixel, call tracking, and form submissions fire before scaling budget.

recommendations.title: Test smartwatch creative against pendant messaging
recommendations.detail: Category is shifting to wearables and fall detection. Worth testing a watch-forward ad like the Medical Alert Watch against classic pendant creative to match 2026 buyer intent.
